summary_en: 300,000 shares (1.07% of S/O), ¥1.0B upper limit, open-market purchase window Aug 10 to Oct 30, 2026. Rationale: financial strategy for responsive capital policy and shareholder returns per 2024 mid-term plan.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Own Shares
translation_en_brief: On 7 August 2026, Mitsuboshi Belting's board resolved to acquire up to 300,000 of its own shares (1.07% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum of ¥1.0 billion via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 10 August and 30 October 2026. The acquisition is undertaken as part of the company's financial strategy to pursue responsive capital policy in response to changing business conditions and as a component of the shareholder return measures outlined in the mid-term management plan announced on 14 May 2024. As of 31 July 2026, the company held 3,113,361 treasury shares against 27,990,837 shares outstanding (excluding treasury).
